headline: The co-op kitchens finally ship their takes
lede: SHORT ORDER SHOUT, BOMB DEFUSE and RALLY CO-DRIVER now have live proof that a consented phone run records at seed-birth, ends naturally and lands in the PLAICRAFT store — byte-audited and replay-verified by the studio's own grader. Gauntlet and the clap test had this evidence; these three games never did. 43 of 43 checks green on one busy box.

notes.text: npm run cooptakes drives each co-op game phone-shaped (mobile context, fake-file mic, relaysim store): consent gate answered like a person, recorder open at seed-birth, real keystrokes banked (1577 pressed pads booked across one Bomb Defuse shift), the run ending by its OWN rules (strike whistle / fold / pace-brain lap), then a store round-trip whose downloaded bytes validate v1/v2, match press counts, and replay-verify through plaicraft:evidence.

Honest seats proven live: SOS and BOMB DEFUSE stamp seat 0 human (#2058); Rally on ?seat=model keeps seat 0 honestly 'model' — the humanSeats:false opt-out demonstrated on a real 8400-tick run, not just pinned in Node. Bomb Defuse solo was the trap: one seat plays and the partner cover stream feeds the recorder, so the honest recording shape needs two human seats.

Consent axes, live: a NO-THANKS run leaves the store's minute untouched; motion-yes-voice-no lands a silent honest v1; and revoking voice at the last-moment dialog strips the section from the uploaded bytes — the mutant that ignores that strip goes RED at exactly that gate (#1711's mutant-that-tries, caught by name). Mic-off-at-gate mutants are vacuous: no mic, no voice section, nothing to strip.

Factory hazard, filed as #2758: a reaped session's children kept serving and recording in the shared daemon while its replacement spawned — two writers briefly shared one worktree. Mutateguard held (one mutant run self-refused on the dirty tree) and nothing wrong shipped, but reaping must kill the slot's process group, not just the session pid.
